scope: all reachable Git blob objects, including text, binary, oversized media and previous commits
exact_local_provider_and_admin_credentia: absent from all reachable Git blobs

limits: Known-pattern and exact-value scanning cannot prove absence of unknown secret formats or recover secrets encoded in image pixels.
